description: Generic admin web panel (React 19 + TypeScript strict + Vite): app shell with sidebar/rail/drawer, top bar, alerts bell, light/dark, RTL default + LTR, Arabic + English locale areas (lazy per screen), e-mail + password + e-mail OTP sign-in with an idle-timed sessionStorage session, registry-driven settings, audit log, exports, alerts, profile, the contract-typed data layer (api:sync from the server OpenAPI, envelope + error codes, pagination), design tokens, dev-only component gallery, local gate (verify + four variant builds + size budgets), qa/ scripts for a local real stack, docs templates (PRD, BRD, Design Script, Tasks, E2E results) and the agent rules in CLAUDE.md + .claude/. One sample module `items` (list + detail + create/edit drawer, reason-required writes) matching the server template's /admin/v1/items.

notes.server_contract: ../__SERVER_DIR__/docs/api/openapi.admin.json; `contract/openapi.admin.json` is the committed snapshot the panel was generated from (items, alerts, exports, settings, audit-logs, profile, auth) — run `npm run api:sync` once the server template is in place
notes.urls: __DEV_API_URL__ and __PROD_API_URL__ must be https origins (tests/envFiles.test.ts and the prod builds enforce it)
notes.after_generation: replace src/assets/app-icon.png, `common.currency` in src/locales/*/core.json and BUSINESS_TIME_ZONE in src/constants/kernel.ts for the product
